identity.description: A rounded paper tab with a tiny perforation/notch and a single clinical rule line, derived from the game's sweet stationery, doctor setting, bell/menu UI, and later threat rather than copied game art.

surfaceTint.use: section tabs, selected cards, subtle separators

ink.use: primary text and dark player/footer surface

roseAction.use: Play Now, active navigation, links, primary focus accents

warningGold.use: warning labels and failure/status edge paired with text/icon

danger.use: explicit destructive or content warning states

data.role: status, control keys, version and compact metadata

typography.gameArticleMaxWidth: none; always the complete left grid track
typography.guideReadingMeasure: 68ch default, fluid to full mobile width

interaction.focus: 3px solid #F3C44E with 3px #211722 offset on light surfaces; inverse ring on dark surfaces
interaction.hover: color, border, and shadow only; no scale or layout shift
interaction.pressed: inset shadow plus 1px translateY, removed under reduced motion
interaction.disabled: 55% opacity plus disabled cursor and explicit text state
interaction.loading: reserved geometry, status text, and subtle 900ms opacity pulse
interaction.error: warningGold/danger edge, failure icon, plain-language reason, and retry button
interaction.reducedMotion: remove pulse, transforms, smooth scrolling, and non-essential transitions
